text:
sara_support: Customer (Gravity Labs, tenant=acme-prod) reports specific request IDs visible in their app logs but nothing shows in Trace Viewer for those IDs. They say the dashboard shows "No spans found" and timeline is empty for the request. Example request id: r-0a1b2c3d at 2025-11-12T15:04:22Z.
sara_support: They attached a screenshot and said it started after last week's config change to the proxy layer. Customer asking for root cause and ETA.
ben_engineer: Can you paste one exact request id + tenant + approximate timestamp? I'll try to query the trace index.
sara_support: r-0a1b2c3d, tenant=acme-prod, ts approx 2025-11-12T15:04:22Z. Logs show X-Request-ID present on frontend.
ben_engineer: running quick query: `select * from traces where request_id="r-0a1b2c3d" limit 10` -> returns 0 rows.
ben_engineer: checking spans ingest around that time: `select count(*) from spans where tenant="acme-prod" and ts between "2025-11-12T15:03:00Z" and "2025-11-12T15:06:00Z"` -> 72 spans total, but none have request_id=r-0a1b2c3d.
raj_infra: paste of agent logs from trace-router at 15:04:22: `WARN trace_router: span received without request_id, src=ingest-gpu-07, trace_id=7f4a2b..., reason=header_lookup_failed`
raj_infra: also saw `INFO proxy-filter: removed header X-Request-ID for route /api/v1/exec` in proxy logs at 15:04:21.
sara_support: Customer insists their frontend header is `X-Request-ID: r-0a1b2c3d` — I'll paste their original curl: `curl -H "X-Request-ID: r-0a1b2c3d" https://api.acme.example.com/execute` -> server logs show the header.
sara_support: But our trace index shows spans with a different header present: `x-rw-rqid` on many spans (observed in raw span JSON), e.g. span.meta: "x-rw-rqid": "r-0a1b2c3d".
eva_oncall: We rolled out a proxy change last night that rewrites incoming headers for tenant isolation. The change maps `X-Request-ID` -> `x-rw-rqid` and then strips original header in the request forwarded to backend. Looks like trace-router expects `request.request_id` field populated from header `X-Request-ID` but ingest path only preserves `x-rw-rqid` in span meta.
ben_engineer: So we have spans, but the linking layer only looks at `request_id` field (populated from `X-Request-ID`) and not the `x-rw-rqid` meta key. That explains why query by request_id returns empty.
ben_engineer: Quick repro I ran: injected a span with meta `x-rw-rqid=r-xxxx` and the trace_mapper did not populate request_id -> link failed.
raj_infra: short term options: 1) rollback proxy header rewrite (high customer impact), 2) hotfix trace-router to accept fallback headers when request_id is missing, 3) run reingest job to backfill request_id from span meta for affected time window.
sara_support: Customer SLA is 4h for this tenant. They want something visible quickly, at least a mitigation.
eva_oncall: I can push a config to proxy to preserve the original `X-Request-ID` header (preserve original header in addition to x-rw-rqid) as a fast rollback-safe mitigation. That should allow router to see request_id again.
eng-release: I'll prepare a small runtime hotfix to let trace-router accept `x-rw-rqid` and `x-rw-requestid` as fallback keys when `request_id` is missing. Patch preview: ```js
// in trace_router header normalization
const rid = headers['x-request-id'] || headers['x-rw-requestid'] || headers['x-rw-rqid'];
if (rid) span.request_id = rid;
```
eng-release: Can push to canary immediately, then to prod within 30-45m if stable.
ben_engineer: After hotfix we should also run a targeted reindex for 15:00-15:10 to backfill links so Trace Viewer surfaces historical spans for those requests. That is a lower-priority async job but important for the customer.
oncall-bot: incident created INC-5621 by sara_support, severity=high, owner=eng-runtime, linked jira INF-2387.
sara_support: Customer updated, told them we have a canary hotfix and proxy-preserve option; they'll accept a two-step plan: (1) hotfix + canary to restore immediate linking, (2) backfill reingest for full history.
eva_oncall: I'll enable preserve-header flag for acme-prod route now. Pushing change...
sara_support: Confirmed with customer — after preserve-header flip they tried a failing request id and Trace Viewer now shows the span link. :thumbsup:
ben_engineer: will monitor canary metrics (linking success rate, error counts) and push runtime hotfix to prod in 30m.
eng-release: Hotfix deployed to canary at 1953217800, no regressions. Scheduling prod rollout at 1953219000.
ben_engineer: creating runbook steps for reingest backfill: identify spans with meta `x-rw-rqid` and populate request_id, then re-run trace stitching job for affected time window.
sara_support: Customer satisfied for now, asked for postmortem and permanent fix timeline.
eng-release: I'll open INF-2387 with details, assign to eng-runtime, include rollback/mitigation steps, and schedule postmortem.
raj_infra: follow-up action: add header-normalization unit tests and add observability counter for "spans_missing_request_id".
sara_support: thanks everyone — closing loop with customer and will post the incident notes to #postmortems when available.
